summary: The prior audit is directionally right on the pipeline but wrong on two of its twelve verdicts, and both errors are in the "nothing exists" direction — it declared manual sequence enrollment and AI reply drafting entirely absent when both are built and reachable in production. Verified true: detection runs on the `sync-delta` cron (vercel.json `3,18,33,48 * * * *`, 49 crons total, `detect-expired-listings` genuinely absent), `/admin/prospecting` is nav-reachable via `lib/admin/nav.ts:131-141` gated by `prospecting.view` (granted to `broker`, `lib/admin/capabilities.ts:94`), and all four legacy surfaces are redirect stubs. Verified false: item 12 ("missing") is actually HAVE — `manualEnrollPerson` (lib/crm/enroll.ts:168) is wired through `setSequenceEnrollment` (app/actions/crm-membership.ts:71) into the Automations sheet rendered on every contact page (app/admin/(protected)/crm/[id]/page.tsx:647), plus a bulk `enroll_workflow` action; the auditor grepped three names that don't exist and stopped. Item 11's "no AI reply feature exists anywhere" is also false — `aiSmsDraftAction` (app/actions/crm-inbox.ts:409-474) calls claude-opus-4-8 with brand-voice hard rules and is wired into the mobile inbox pill strip; it is mobile-only and on-demand rather than preloaded, which is the real gap. Item 4 overstated the fix cost (personId is already on ProspectRow and already renders an "Open in CRM" link on the card and detail panel). Two material scope facts the auditor missed entirely: detection is hard-filtered to six cities and ListPrice > $500,000 (lib/expired-listing-processor.ts:54-61), and when skip-trace returns no phone or email NO CRM lead is created at all (lines 288-296) — so "load into CRM" silently fails for every unreachable owner.

items.requirement: 1. Detect immediately when a listing comes off market. Skip-trace the owner. Load into CRM.
items.evidence: lib/sync/deltaSync.ts:48 (import) and :600 `await processNewExpiredListings(sb, { maxPerRun: 10, lookbackHours: 2 })` inside a try/catch that logs and continues (:603). vercel.json `/api/cron/sync-delta` schedule `3,18,33,48 * * * *` — confirmed present; parsed all 49 cron entries, zero match /expire|prospect/, so `/api/cron/detect-expired-listings` is genuinely NOT scheduled (auditor correct). lib/expired-listing-processor.ts:54-61 SERVICE_AREA_CITIES = Bend, Redmond, Sisters, Sunriver, Tumalo, La Pine; MIN_LIST_PRICE = 500_000. Skip-trace chain: lib/owner-resolution.mjs:88 (BATCHDATA_API_KEY), lib/expired-owner-lookup.ts:226 (TRACERFY_API_KEY, warns+returns null when missing), :368 (APIFY_API_TOKEN, returns null when missing). CRM load: lib/expired-listing-processor.ts:267-283 ensureNativeLead, :337-364 enrichNativeLead, :385-390 createNativeTask.
items.gap: [CORRECTED: auditor wrote "None material" and missed two hard scope limits that are visible in the same file it cited.] (a) Detection only fires for six cities and only above $500,000 (lines 54-61). Every expired/canceled/withdrawn listing outside that box is invisible to the entire workflow. It is a documented Matt directive (2026-05-19), not a bug, but "detect when a listing comes off market" is materially narrower than stated. (b) lib/expired-listing-processor.ts:288-296 — when `hasReachableOwnerContact(owner)` is false, NO crm_people row is created at all (`skippedFub = true`, `stats.fub_skipped_no_contact++`). The listing is recorded in expired_listings and Matt gets an email, but the lead never enters the CRM, so it can never appear in /admin/prospecting's worklist as a person. (c) All three skip-trace providers fail SILENTLY on a missing env key (return null / console.warn), and the code's own error copy at expired-owner-lookup.ts:461,576 says "check BATCHDATA_API_KEY on Vercel" — implying this has already happened in production once. There is no gate or alarm that fires if the skip-trace chain degrades to zero hits.
items.why_it_matters: The pipeline is genuinely wired and running, but its practical coverage is a fraction of "every expired listing," and its most common failure mode (skip-trace returns nothing) produces zero CRM records with no alarm.

items.requirement: 2. In the CRM it must be obvious this is an expired/canceled/withdrawn listing, with the FULL listing story attached and easy to find (listed date, who listed it, list price, price drops, DOM, when off market, ever under contract, ownership tenure).
items.evidence: buildListingNote at lib/expired-listing-processor.ts:139-195 — verified it emits status + off-market date, address, MLS #, subdivision, taxlot, last list price, original list price with computed drop $ and %, DOM, beds/baths/sqft, prior list agent + email, owner contact block, compliance tags, and two links. Written as `originNote` at :360-364. Tags at :339-351 include the plain status tag + `intent:expired-listing`. Richer story in lib/data/prospecting/types.ts:110-143 (ProspectPriceCycle[] priceHistory, priorListAgentName, priorListOfficeName, originalListPrice, cumulativeDaysOnMarket) rendered only under /admin/prospecting. app/admin/(protected)/expired-listings/[key]/page.tsx is now a redirect to /admin/prospecting?kind=expired&id=<key>.
items.gap: [VERIFIED, with two additions.] Auditor's two named absences are real: grepped yearsOwned/ownershipLength/purchaseDate/deedDate/lastSaleDate/ownedSince/ownership across lib/owner-resolution.mjs, lib/expired-owner-lookup.ts, lib/data/prospecting/, lib/cma/expired-audit.ts — zero hits, ownership tenure exists nowhere. "Ever under contract" also absent (the only `pending` reference in lib/data/prospecting/types.ts:64 is a do-not-solicit guard for currently-on-market, not listing history). ADDITIONS the auditor missed: (1) the LISTED DATE — an explicitly named requirement — is not in buildListingNote either; the note carries the off-market date and DOM but never the original list date. (2) The origin note is a frozen text blob written once at detection; nothing refreshes it, so a subsequent price drop or relist never updates the CRM story. Auditor's core claim stands: the curated story lives on /admin/prospecting, not on /admin/crm/[id].
items.why_it_matters: Matt asked for this to be obvious IN THE CRM. Three of the eight named data points (listed date, ever-under-contract, ownership tenure) are not captured anywhere in the codebase, and the rest are split across two admin surfaces.

items.requirement: 3. Send outreach as SMS or email.
items.evidence: Confirmed by reading both files. components/admin/prospecting/ProspectSendDialog.client.tsx:65 declares `sendEmailIntroAction?` as OPTIONAL with a doc comment saying "the parent may leave this undefined ... until an email intro path ships"; :291 `sendDisabled` includes `(channel === 'email' && !sendEmailIntroAction)`; :378-382 renders the inline note "Email intro sending isn't available yet. Use Send test to preview the wording." app/admin/(protected)/prospecting/page.tsx:88-99 passes exactly buildAction, prepareSendAction, sendIntroAction, sendTestAction, approveAction — no sendEmailIntroAction. Grepped app/actions/prospecting.ts: no email-intro implementation exists.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Accurate as written. Worth adding that this is not an oversight but an explicit v1 scope decision documented in the component's own JSDoc ("spec 07 §5.1 scopes the guarded cold intro to SMS only") and again at :78-82. The Email tab, the EmailBodyEditor, the merge-field resolution, and the send-test path are all built — only the guarded production send action is missing, so the remaining work is one server action plus one prop, not a new subsystem.
items.why_it_matters: Owners in the 'no-phone' compliance bucket have no working send path at all, and the dialog advertises an Email tab that cannot send.

items.requirement: 4. A send dialog showing the lead name and the CMA/audit. Clicking the lead name opens the lead. Clicking the audit opens the audit.
items.evidence: ProspectSendDialog.client.tsx:120 `Send to {context?.ownerName ?? 'owner'}` (plain text), :296-299 recipient block (plain text), :386-395 anchor to `/admin/cmas/{context.docSlug}` target=_blank. ProspectSendContext at app/actions/prospecting.ts:399-412 — confirmed no personId field. BUT: components/admin/prospecting/ProspectCard.client.tsx:59 `const crmHref = row.personId ? `/admin/crm/${row.personId}` : null`, rendered as a real Link at :86-90 ("Open in CRM" dropdown item) and again at :159-166 (full-width button). components/admin/prospecting/ProspectDetailPanel.client.tsx:69 does the same from the detail drawer.
items.gap: [CORRECTED: the auditor claimed wiring this "requires a DAL change, not just a template tweak" — that is wrong.] `personId` is ALREADY on both ProspectRow and ProspectDetail and already renders as a working "Open in CRM" link in two places on the same screen (the card and the detail panel). The only missing piece is threading that existing field into ProspectSendContext and making the dialog title an anchor. No DAL work, no new query. The auditor also under-reported the current state: a broker does NOT have to "close it and search manually" — the card the dialog was opened from already carries the link.
items.why_it_matters: Real but minor. The named ask (clickable lead name inside the dialog) is unbuilt, but the workflow is not actually blocked, and the fix is a field pass-through.

items.evidence: app/actions/prospecting.ts:381-395 approveProspectDoc — requireAdmin guard, delegates to approveCmaAction, revalidates caches. ProspectSendDialog.client.tsx:172-186 needsApproval banner + handleApprove; :291 sendDisabled includes `needsApproval`; :419-427 the Send button renders 'Approve first' when unapproved and 'Already sent' when context.alreadySent. Server-side re-guard confirmed in the send path. The dialog also refuses to close mid-send (:107-114 sendPendingRef).
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Real and reachable. One thing the auditor did not check but I did: the dialog is only reachable from /admin/prospecting, which is nav-registered at lib/admin/nav.ts:131-141 under capability `prospecting.view`, granted to role `broker` at lib/admin/capabilities.ts:94. So the flow is live for brokers, not superuser-only. No gap.
items.why_it_matters: This is the compliance gate between a draft audit and a text message reaching a homeowner, and it holds on both client and server.

items.requirement: 6. The dialog preloads our existing expired-listing initial-contact template (SMS version and email version).
items.evidence: Read supabase/migrations/20260718120300_seed_prospecting_templates.sql in full: two INSERTs, both `'sms'` channel — expired-first-touch-sell-v1 and fsbo-first-touch-v1, both guarded by NOT EXISTS. No email row. app/actions/prospecting.ts:438-451 prepareProspectSend reads crm_templates with `.eq('channel','sms').eq('is_active',true)` and renders merge tokens through renderCrmMerge; :453-457 hard-codes defaultEmailSubject and defaultEmailBody as string literals in the action file.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Confirmed line by line. Two caveats the auditor should have flagged: (1) the SMS read has NO fallback — `tpl?.body ? render(...) : ''` at :448-451 means if the template row is missing or inactive in production the dialog silently preloads an EMPTY message box, with no error surfaced. (2) The seed migration is NOT_EXISTS-guarded and its own header says the live rows already exist in hosted Supabase, so the repo cannot prove what channel rows production actually holds — an email-channel row could exist in the hosted DB. Per the no-ad-hoc-SQL rule I did not query it; treat 'no email template' as verified-in-repo, unverified-in-production.
items.why_it_matters: Only the SMS half is a DB-backed editable template. The email copy is baked into a server action and cannot change without a deploy — and, per item 3, cannot send at all.

items.requirement: 7. In the dialog: tweak the message, save as a new template, switch templates, add more recipients, CC the broker.
items.evidence: Tweak: ProspectSendDialog.client.tsx:351-358 editable Textarea, bodyOverride honored server-side (app/actions/prospecting.ts:195-198, 244-251). ALSO PRESENT and unreported by the auditor: a MergeFieldInserter is rendered for both channels (:347 for SMS, and the EmailBodyEditor path at :366-373), plus live unresolved-token warnings at :359-364 and :374-376. Re-grepped for save-as-template / template switcher / CC / additional-recipient UI across components/ and app/ — zero hits in the prospecting tree; ProspectSendContext (app/actions/prospecting.ts:399-412) and the sendIntroAction signature (:78-82) carry no cc or recipients field.
items.gap: [CORRECTED: status raised from "missing" to "partial" — the auditor's own evidence showed a working sub-capability, so "missing" was the wrong label, and it under-counted what exists.] Two of the five capabilities in this ask are built (tweak the message; insert merge fields with unresolved-token validation), not one. Still genuinely absent: save-as-new-template, switch-template, add-recipients, CC-the-broker. Those four require both UI and a signature change to sendIntroAction, which today takes exactly one prospect and resolves exactly one contact point.
items.why_it_matters: Still the largest spec gap in the workflow, but the dialog is closer to the ask than the prior audit implied — the compose surface is real and validated, it just cannot fan out or persist.

items.requirement: 8. Filter the expired listing view by: audit sent / audit not sent.
items.evidence: lib/data/prospecting/types.ts:146-152 ProspectStatusFilter union. components/admin/prospecting/ProspectFilters.client.tsx:33-42 STATUS_OPTIONS renders all six (All, Ready to send, Needs audit, Sent, Excluded, No phone) and :46-54 round-trips them through the querystring. app/admin/(protected)/prospecting/page.tsx:28 STATUS whitelist and :50-53 validate the `status` param before it reaches the DAL.
items.gap: [VERIFIED] Confirmed reachable and server-validated. Superset of the ask, no shortfall.
items.why_it_matters: Gives the broker the sent vs not-sent worklist split that was asked for, plus the compliance buckets.

items.requirement: 9. On the contact page: see that a CMA/audit was sent, when they opened it, what they clicked.
items.evidence: Verified the exact lines. app/admin/(protected)/crm/[id]/page.tsx:290-298 builds emailEngagement only from `t.kind === 'email_open' || 'email_click'`; :379 the rendered timeline filters OUT email_open, email_click AND sms_click; :392-393 `opens`/`clicks` badges are set only `if (t.kind === 'email_out')`. Confirmed sms_click events ARE written — lib/data/crm/shortLinks.ts:164-176 inserts kind 'sms_click' with a dedupe key on every short-link tap. Confirmed lib/data/crm/getContactActivityFeed.ts:55 maps sms_click to a friendly label 'Text link clicked' — but grepped the whole tree for getContactActivityFeed and found ZERO callers, so that mapping is dead code. Doc engagement (reportViews/linkTaps) is computed in lib/data/prospecting/engagement.ts and surfaced only in ProspectSendContext and ProspectCard.client.tsx:110-117.
items.gap: [VERIFIED, and worse than reported.] The auditor was right and understated it. sms_click rows are being written to crm_timeline on every audit-link tap, the human-readable label for them already exists in getContactActivityFeed.ts:55, and that entire reader has no callers anywhere in the app. So the contact page actively filters out data it already has, and the one module that would render it is dead. Since expired outreach is SMS-only (item 3), the net effect is that a broker on /admin/crm/[id] can see the send happened but has zero signal on whether the audit was opened or clicked.
items.why_it_matters: The data exists, is captured, and is deliberately excluded from the one surface Matt named. This is a rendering gap, not a data gap, which makes it cheap and makes leaving it unfixed harder to justify.

items.requirement: 10. Reporting: who is left to reach out to, who I reached, who is opening, who looks interested, who needs follow-up.
items.evidence: lib/data/prospecting/list.ts computeSummary buckets total/sendable/needsAudit/sent/excluded/noPhone. ProspectCard.client.tsx:52-55 hasEngagement gate, :115-120 renders "N views · N taps · last <date>" only when nonzero. Listed app/admin/(protected)/reports/: brokers, custom, emails, lead-flow, leads, market, traffic-sources — none scoped to prospecting. Grepped both files that mention expired: reports/leads/page.tsx:15 explicitly EXCLUDES bulk prospecting/import lists (Farm, Import, Sphere, Expired) from its counts; reports/lead-flow/page.tsx:106 tracks the `/lp/expired-listing` LANDING PAGE funnel, a different thing from outreach. Grepped lib/data/prospecting/list.ts for sort — the only sort is `.sort()` on the city list at :200; there is no sort-by-engagement.
items.gap: [VERIFIED, sharpened.] Confirmed no prospecting report page exists and no engagement sort exists. Two sharpenings the auditor missed: (1) reports/leads/page.tsx:15 does not merely omit expired leads, it deliberately excludes them from the lead numbers, so the one existing lead report actively hides this cohort. (2) ProspectCard only renders the engagement line when there is activity, so "opened but no reply" and "never opened" are visually identical to "not yet loaded" — a broker scanning the sent bucket cannot distinguish them without opening each row.
items.why_it_matters: Three of the five questions Matt named (who is opening, who looks interested, who needs follow-up) have no answering surface, and the closest existing report is built to exclude this cohort by design.

items.requirement: 11. Reply handling: STOP -> stop SMS, mark in CRM, never contact again. Real reply -> notify the broker, show the thread, PRELOAD a recommended reply using merge fields, system recommends next step, broker can override.
items.evidence: STOP path confirmed at app/api/twilio/inbound-sms/route.ts:147-154 (addSuppression channel sms, reason stop-keyword, + system timeline row) with TOCTOU re-checks before the Twilio call at app/actions/prospecting.ts:172-182 and :253-258. Reply alerting confirmed at :174-256 (queueBrokerAlert, crm_tasks 'Reply to text', emailed alert deep-linking /admin/crm/{id}#comms, awaited SMS forward to the broker cell). AI DRAFTING EXISTS — app/actions/crm-inbox.ts:409-474 `aiSmsDraftAction`: admin-guarded + person-scope-guarded, pulls getInboxContactCard + getConversationThread(id, 12), calls Anthropic claude-opus-4-8 with a system prompt carrying the brand-voice hard rules (no em dashes, no semicolons, banned-word list, "never invent market numbers"), returns a ≤320-char draft. Wired: app/admin/(protected)/crm/inbox/page.tsx:34,365-372 (aiDraftFor server wrapper), :546-547, into components/admin/crm/inbox/mobile/MobileAiPills.tsx:28-44, MobileThread.tsx:430,612, MobileComposeSheet.tsx:267. Next-step recommendation also exists: lib/crm/next-step.ts decideContactNextStep, consumed at app/admin/(protected)/crm/[id]/page.tsx:154,243,615-636.
items.gap: [CORRECTED: the auditor wrote "No AI-generated/recommended reply feature exists anywhere" and "does not exist at all" — both are false.] A production AI reply drafter exists, is brand-voice constrained, is auth- and scope-guarded, and is reachable today. The auditor grepped suggestedReply/recommendedReply/nextStep/AI-reply and missed it because it is named aiSmsDraftAction/aiDraftAction; it also missed lib/crm/next-step.ts, which is literally the "system recommends next step" sub-ask and is rendered on every contact page. The REAL gaps, which are narrower: (a) the AI draft is wired ONLY into the mobile inbox branch — ls of components/admin/crm/inbox shows InlineReply.tsx, InboxThreadView.tsx and the rest of the desktop tree have no aiDraft prop, so a broker on desktop has no access; (b) it is on-demand (tap a pill) rather than PRELOADED into the compose field on an inbound reply, which is what Matt asked for; (c) it hard-fails closed when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is unset (:420) with no alarm; (d) it drafts from thread history and contact card only, not from merge fields or the expired-listing story. Broker override is inherent (the draft lands in an editable field).
items.why_it_matters: The prior audit would have had Matt fund a feature that is already 60% built. The actual work is desktop parity plus an auto-preload trigger, not a new AI service. STOP compliance is solid and defense-in-depth.

items.requirement: 12. Optional enrollment into a scheduled expired drip workflow with defined steps and timing.
items.evidence: lib/crm/enroll.ts:168-217 `manualEnrollPerson(personId, sequenceId, enrolledBy)` — read in full: validates input, requires the sequence exist and be `status='active'`, checks crm_suppressions channel='all' and FAILS CLOSED on a read error, refuses double-enroll into a live enrollment, inserts crm_sequence_enrollments status='running' with next_run_at=now(), and writes a crm_timeline audit row "Enrolled in <name> by <broker>". Critically, it does NOT apply the outreach-list exclusion — that guard lives only in autoEnrollPerson at :59. Wired: app/actions/crm-membership.ts:34 imports manualEnrollPerson, :71 setSequenceEnrollment (getCrmAccess + requirePersonInScope guarded), consumed by components/admin/crm/ContactQuickActions.tsx:16,152-182 (Automations sheet), rendered at app/admin/(protected)/crm/[id]/page.tsx:647-650 with `automations={contactMemberships.sequences}`. lib/data/crm/getContactMemberships.ts:11,17-20 confirms that list is EVERY ACTIVE workflow left-joined to this person's enrollments "so the broker can flip it ON" — not just already-enrolled ones. Second path: components/admin/crm/bulk/registry.tsx:137-158 enroll_workflow bulk action -> bulkEnrollWorkflowAction, surfaced as "Apply Automation" at BulkActions.tsx:415. The sequence engine cron is live (vercel.json /api/cron/crm-sequence-engine `13,28,43,58 * * * *`).
items.gap: [CORRECTED: the auditor marked this "missing" and asserted "There is no code path, by directive, that enrolls an expired lead into any drip sequence — automatic or optional-manual." That is flatly wrong.] Manual per-lead enrollment is built, guarded, audited, and reachable on the contact page of every expired lead, plus a bulk variant. The auditor grepped enrollPersonAction/manualEnroll/assignSequence and concluded absence; the actual names are manualEnrollPerson and setSequenceEnrollment, and the UI is a toggle sheet labeled "Automations," not an "enroll" button. It also misread the architecture: the 2026-06-09 outreach-list exclusion at lib/crm/enroll.ts:51-59 is scoped to autoEnrollPerson ONLY and has no effect on the manual path, so its claim that expired drip enrollment is "categorically forbidden with no override" is incorrect. What IS true and remains true: AUTOMATIC enrollment is paused by directive (lib/expired-listing-processor.ts:377-387, `void autoEnrollPerson` with a documented restore path). That is exactly the optional/manual-only posture the requirement asked for.
items.why_it_matters: This was the auditor's single worst call. The capability Matt asked for as optional is built and shipped; presenting it as unbuilt would have triggered a redundant L-effort project.

shared_primitives_needed: Thread the already-existing `personId` (present on ProspectRow / ProspectDetail) into ProspectSendContext so any compose dialog can render an 'open the lead' link — no DAL work required, contrary to the prior audit

A recipient/CC model for outbound sends — every composer signature today resolves exactly one contact point (sendProspectingIntro takes kind+id only); cc and additional-recipients do not exist in any send action

A template-management primitive (list / select / save-as-new) shared across SmsComposer, EmailComposer and ProspectSendDialog, replacing per-surface hardcoded template keys, plus a non-empty fallback so a missing crm_templates row cannot silently preload a blank message

Revive lib/data/crm/getContactActivityFeed.ts (currently zero callers) or otherwise stop app/admin/(protected)/crm/[id]/page.tsx:379 from filtering out sms_click, and join prospecting doc-engagement (reportViews/linkTaps) into the contact timeline
Desktop parity for the existing aiSmsDraftAction (today wired only into components/admin/crm/inbox/mobile/*), plus an auto-preload trigger on inbound reply rather than tap-to-generate
A skip-trace health alarm — BatchData, Tracerfy and Apify all degrade silently to null on a missing key, and a total-failure run currently produces zero CRM leads with no signal
A prospecting/outreach reporting surface with sort-by-engagement and an 'opened but no reply' segment; reports/leads currently excludes this cohort by design (reports/leads/page.tsx:15)
open_questions_for_owner: Detection is hard-limited to six cities and listings over $500,000 (lib/expired-listing-processor.ts:54-61, your 2026-05-19 directive). Everything below that floor or outside those cities never enters the workflow. Is that still the intended scope?

When skip-trace returns no phone and no email, no CRM lead is created at all — you get the alert email and an expired_listings audit row, but nothing to work. Do you want a contact-less placeholder lead so those addresses stay on a worklist, or is dropping them correct?

Do you want production email sending built for expired outreach, or is SMS the sole channel going forward? Everything except the guarded send action is already built (Email tab, editor, merge fields, send-test).

Should 'save as new template' / 'switch templates' / 'add recipients' / 'CC the broker' be built into the prospecting send dialog specifically, or as a composer-level upgrade all CRM send surfaces inherit?

The AI text drafter exists but only in the mobile inbox and only on tap. Do you want it on desktop and auto-preloaded into the reply field when an inbound reply lands, or is tap-to-draft on mobile enough?

Ownership tenure (how long they have owned it) and whether the listing ever went under contract are captured nowhere in the pipeline. Both would need a new data source. Worth buying, or drop them from the story?
Manual drip enrollment already works from the contact page's Automations sheet. Do you want the expired auto-enroll (plan 71, paused 2026-07-11) restored, or does the manual toggle cover it?

docs/plans/EXPIRED_WORKFLOW_AUDIT_2026-07-03.md describes a FUB-era architecture that was rewritten twice since. Also, app/admin/(protected)/expired-listings/page.tsx's comment claims the [key] detail page 'remains' when that page is itself now a redirect. Should both be corrected so future audits stop reading them as current?
